summary: Keep dev/test workspace debug information in unpacked sidecars, reducing local test build size while preserving file:line backtraces.

replay.detail: Build profiles only; no replay or projection change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or authority rule change.

compatibility.detail: No runtime or protocol change. Existing CI debug-info overrides and release profiles are unchanged.

manual.detail: Keep .dwo sidecars with local build trees for file:line backtraces; Cargo manages them in the target directory.

recovery.detail: No data recovery change; rebuild artifacts if debug sidecars are removed.
